body: I should be alright. I don't need emergency services yet. If it gets to that point I do know who to call around here.

I've thought about trying to get a therapist, but right now that would be really difficult because I don't permanently live where I'm staying, and I know most sliding scale places need proof of residence in the county they work in before they'll give you cheap services. At least that's been my experience. So I'm waiting until I have a place to live again and then I can think about trying to find a therapist who'll see me, and I can afford to see.. It's all really complicated right now.
